The '''2020 Copa Libertadores final stages''' were played from 24 November 2020 to 30 January 2021.<ref name="calendar_new">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/calendario_2020_version_pos_pandemia_06_07_2020_aprobado_consejo.pdf|title=CALENDÁRIO 2020|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/es/clubes-reciben-informe-detallado-sobre-torneos-de-la-conmebol|title=Clubes reciben informe detallado sobre torneos de la CONMEBOL|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=23 November 2020|language=es}}</ref> A total of 16 teams competed in the final stages to decide the champions of the [[2020 Copa Libertadores]],<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/docs2020/Manual-de-Clubes-Libertadores-2020-es.pdf|title=Manual de Clubes / Reglamento CONMEBOL Libertadores 2020|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|language=es}}</ref> with the final played in [[Rio de Janeiro]], [[Brazil]] at the [[Maracanã Stadium|Estádio do Maracanã]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/conmebol-designa-maracana-rio-y-mario-kempes-cordoba-sedes-de-las-finales-unicas-de-libertadores-y|title=El Maracaná (Río) y el Mario Kempes (Córdoba) sedes de las Finales Únicas de Libertadores y Sudamericana 2020|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=17 October 2019|language=es}}</ref>

The final stages had been originally scheduled to be played from 21 July to 21 November 2020, but were postponed due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic]].<ref name="calendar">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/calendario_2020_aprobado_consejo_13_06_2019.pdf|title=CALENDÁRIO 2020: CONMEBOL Libertadores - CONMEBOL Sudamericana - RECOPA|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref>

==Format==
<section begin=Format />
Starting from the round of 16, the teams played a [[single-elimination tournament]] with the following rules:<ref name="regulations"/>
*In the round of 16, quarter-finals and semi-finals, each tie was played on a home-and-away [[two-legged tie|two-legged]] basis, with the higher-seeded team hosting the second leg (Regulations Article 2.2.3.2). If tied on aggregate, the [[away goals rule]] was used. If still tied, [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra time]] was not played, and a [[penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] was used to determine the winners (Regulations Article 2.4.3).
*The final was played as a single match at a venue pre-selected by the CONMEBOL, with the higher-seeded team designated as the "home" team for administrative purposes (Regulations Article 2.2.3.5). If tied after regulation, 30 minutes of [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra time]] would be played. If still tied after extra time, a [[penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] would be used to determine the winners (Regulations Article 2.4.4).<section end=Format />

==Draw==
<section begin=Draw />
The draw for the round of 16 was held on 23 October 2020, 12:00 [[Time in Paraguay|PYT]] ([[UTC−03:00|UTC−3]]).<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/se-sortean-los-octavos-de-la-conmebol-libertadores-y-la-segunda-fase-de-la-conmebol-sudamericana|title=Se sortean los Octavos de la CONMEBOL Libertadores y la Segunda Fase de la CONMEBOL Sudamericana|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=12 October 2020|language=es}}</ref> For the round of 16, the 16 teams were drawn into eight ties (A–H) between a group winner (Pot 1) and a group runner-up (Pot 2), with the group winners hosting the second leg. Teams from the same association or the same group could be drawn into the same tie (Regulations Article 2.2.3.2).<ref name="regulations"/><section end=Draw />

==Final==
